credits: Original geometry drawn for Verdant Reach under the Crystal rule (docs/CREATURES.md). Botanical reference: Amorphophallus titanum, https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Amorphophallus_titanum . No sprite from any other game was copied, traced or imported.
notes: Crystal rule. Amorphophallus titanum. BRACED: a huge round brown corm, half buried in a low mound of soil, wider than it is tall, with root feet gripping the ground on both sides; one stubby, mottled shoot rises from the dimple at its top, a thick pointed spike leaning toward the foe with its tip hooked over like a horn. Gesture: the corm pulses (it squashes, swells past its rest size, holds and settles); the soil stays fixed. A maroon-brown dark slot (the corm's shade and skin marks, the stalk's blotches, the spathe's inside) under a mid that turns from olive (corm and leaf) to cream-yellow (the spadix and the spathe's pale outside). Skin marks and blotches always join an edge or the shade, never an enclosed dark dot. Sport: a pale form, an artistic interpretation (no pale titan arum is known).
